spec.purpose: Profile the real16384-token cold owner and32-token continuation using the current qualified q8192 component binaries and unchanged numerical bounds. Enable only five completed-profile options, full markers and existing cold chunk orchestration. Require original GB10 prompt and all32 output IDs, first-logit tolerance0.125, actual callbacks and complete resident ownership. Nested intervals are not additive. Instrumented clocks establish no retained performance, longer-context or release qualification.

timing_scope: One instrumented real16384 cold owner with two8192 chunks and32 original GB10 continuation tokens. No prefix hit or512-token continuation is measured. CK phases are disjoint internally but nested in outer attention. First-chunk probability includes native PV; second-chunk probability and native PV are separate. Shared and routed MoE overlap. Negative/nonfinite GPU intervals are preserved and excluded from totals. Final-query liveness is correctly inactive for both cold chunk transactions. No uninstrumented performance comparison is claimed.
decision: Investigate complete long-attention schedule and arithmetic-preserving reuse of current short-context kernels: second-chunk CK costs36.527s, including11.746s QK,13.161s exact PV and11.062s probability/native PV. Full-attention allocation, H2D and free timings are milliseconds; no evidence supports allocation pooling as the dominant route. Keep qualified q8192 baseline and every acceptance threshold unchanged.
